tess (docs): Hey — I'm landing a compact 'Rate & Quota' migration section. PR: https://rwd/pulls/5233. Needs: 1) tiny examples for Py/TS showing quota check vs generate, 2) explicit header matrix for hosted vs private, 3) wording on burst-credit behavior, and 4) a non-live dashboard artifact.
omar (sdk): I'll update snippets. Quick fact: hosted uses X-Quota-Org; private clusters expose X-Tenant-Quota. Recommend primary pattern: call /quota (preferred) then fall back to headers. I'll add a short table in the PR.
kevin (product): For burst-credit wording: illustrate differences only (not contractual). Suggest one sentence + a tiny illustrative table: Tier | Monthly quota | Example burst credits. Keeps it user-friendly.
mei (analytics): Add a troubleshooting callout: "Tokens vs requests: background jobs (embeddings) can consume tokens without increasing request count." Suggest we show code printing both values to reduce confusion.
tess (docs): Draft Python snippet I added (very compact):

```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
q = c.quota.get()
print(q.tokens_left, q.requests_left)
if q.requests_left:
  resp = c.generate(model="rw-medium", prompt="status")
  print(resp.id, resp.quota_left)
```

omar (sdk): Two small edits: field names are snake_case (tokens_left, requests_left, quota_left) — looks good. Also avoid calling .generate without showing error handling in SDK examples; I'll push a micro-fix with try/except.
kevin (product): Can we also add a one-line note: "If you need per-tenant burst control on dedicated clusters, contact your account team for pool tagging"? Keeps expectations clear.
mei (analytics): For the dashboard, do not point to internal Grafana links in public docs. tess — please attach a sanitized screenshot artifact and add caption: "internal panel (illustrative); panel IDs vary across deployments".
